description: This Java file defines the class 'LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEvent', which is a data model representing a specific type of external business event related to loan transaction adjustments. It extends a superclass 'BusinessEvent' and contains fields for transaction details, constructors for different scenarios, and a 'verify' method to validate external event payloads.

classes.name: LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEvent
classes.description: A class representing a loan transaction adjustment event with verification capabilities.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Validates if the external event payload matches the expected transaction details.
